provenance.derivation: Only materialization boundaries changed; H2O eager expressions adapted to lazy scans in the Metal worker. CPU expressions and all input dtypes retained. Every collect in Metal query modules explicitly names MetalRuntime; no automatic placement or CPU retry.

h2o_groupby.evidence: docs/benchmarks.md already designates H2O as development

h2o_join.evidence: docs/benchmarks.md already designates H2O as development

pdsh.evidence: dataframe/lazy.mojo join ordering and streaming policy cite PDS-H queries; development since 2026-10-05

tpcds.evidence: added 2026-10-05 as the held-out replacement for PDS-H; no engine change cites it

clickbench.evidence: dataframe/lazy.mojo group-by policy cites ClickBench per-query timings

evaluation.upstream_note: Hashes identify the local query translations, generators and runner. Historical upstream revisions were not recorded; local hashes are not upstream commit pins. DuckDB's version identifies tpch_queries/dbgen and tpcds_queries/dsdgen.

provenance.comparison: Exact full schema and row multiset against original CPU query, retaining duplicate rows. Original-order equality recorded separately. No numerical tolerance, dtype conversion, query rewriting for support, or CPU fallback. Collection durations are diagnostic, not performance evidence.
